limu_1pct.label: 1% labels · random 80/10/10
limu_1pct.split: Random 80% train, 10% validation, 10% test; balanced 1% labeled training subset.
limu_1pct.dataset_variant: 20 Hz, 120-sample non-overlapping IMU sequences; LIMU-GRU classifier or named baseline.
limu_1pct.metric_note: Accuracy and macro-F1; not the official UCI-HAR subject split.

ad_pamap.label: A&D subject holdout
ad_pamap.split: Subject 6 runs 1-2 test; subject 5 runs 1-2 validation; remainder train.

ad_opp.label: A&D gesture split
ad_opp.split: S2/S3 ADL4-5 test; S1 ADL2 validation; remaining runs train.
ad_opp.dataset_variant: OPPORTUNITY gesture, 79 channels, 17 gestures plus Null.
ad_opp.metric_note: Sample-wise macro-F1; differs from canonical 113-channel LOSO.

unimts_full.label: Full-shot · author protocol
unimts_full.split: Author-prepared full-shot evaluation; exact split indices are not re-established here.
unimts_full.dataset_variant: 18 class-specific targets in original Table 2; WISDM has 18 classes, Opportunity 4, PAMAP2 12, USC-HAD 12.
unimts_full.metric_note: Table 2 Acc and macro-F1; no transfer of 18-class WISDM to original WISDM.

robust_15pct.label: 15% labels · 80/10/10
robust_15pct.split: 8:1:1 train/validation/test; 15% of training labels; five trials.
robust_15pct.dataset_variant: OPPORTUNITY 17 activities / 5 devices; RealWorld 8 activities / 13 subjects.
robust_15pct.metric_note: F1 averaging is not specified in Section 4.1; do not label it macro or weighted.

deepsense_original.label: Original HHAR user holdout
deepsense_original.split: One-user-out evaluation in original DeepSense HAR experiment.
deepsense_original.dataset_variant: Original HHAR sensing/preprocessing, not LIMU-BERT 1% labels.
deepsense_original.metric_note: Accuracy; paper reports mean and uncertainty 0.942 ± 0.032.

if_tsf_loso.label: TSF comparison · LOSO
if_tsf_loso.split: LOSO over subjects, repeated three runs, as stated in TSF IV-A3.
if_tsf_loso.dataset_variant: TSF comparison preprocessing; OPPORTUNITY uses Null-inclusive gesture labels.
if_tsf_loso.metric_note: WF1 is weighted-F1; F1 is macro-F1. This is an author comparison paper, not a fresh extraction of the 2022 paper.

if_local_hhar.label: Local segmented HHAR · review
if_local_hhar.split: Saved subject folds, segmented at label/time-gap boundaries.
if_local_hhar.metric_note: Weighted-F1; saved gap is outside tolerance.

if_local_pamap.label: Local PAMAP2 · review
if_local_pamap.metric_note: Weighted-F1; saved gap is outside tolerance.

deepconv_local.label: Saved official checkpoint
deepconv_local.split: Protocol recorded in saved registry; standalone run artifact not found.
deepconv_local.dataset_variant: OPPORTUNITY checkpoint evaluation; check Null handling before comparing.
deepconv_local.metric_note: Weighted-F1; not paired as equivalent to A&D macro-F1.

local_baseline.label: Inspired baseline · archive
local_baseline.split: Official UCI-HAR subject split in saved local run.
local_baseline.dataset_variant: DeepConvLSTM-style reimplementation, not an official-model claim.
local_baseline.metric_note: Accuracy; archived separately from validated method results.

unimts_local_uci.label: Local canonical adapter
unimts_local_uci.split: Project canonical UCI-HAR subject split: 7352 train / 2947 test windows, as saved in input_adapter.
unimts_local_uci.dataset_variant: 6 classes; 50 Hz source, total acceleration xyz plus body gyro xyz; upstream finetune_custom.py, full-shot, 200 epochs.
unimts_local_uci.metric_note: Accuracy; split preparation differs from the author-prepared paper protocol. Registry only.

unimts_local_pamap.label: Local prepared PAMAP split
unimts_local_pamap.split: Saved official UniMTS prepared PAMAP arrays: 13986 train / 2311 test windows. Exact subject indices not re-established.
unimts_local_pamap.dataset_variant: 12 classes; source arrays 100 Hz, shape 1000 × 27 per window; gyro=0 default selects accelerometer channels.
unimts_local_pamap.metric_note: Saved primary weighted-F1 differs from the paper macro-F1. Secondary Accuracy and macro-F1 are retained.

deepsense_local_abc.label: Local HHAR a/b/c · review
deepsense_local_abc.split: Three saved a/b/c folds from public HHAR raw preprocessing; equivalence to the paper user-holdout experiment is pending review.
deepsense_local_abc.dataset_variant: Official TensorFlow-1 model and public HHAR-Data-Process preprocessing; saved note reports a train-count discrepancy in fold c.
deepsense_local_abc.metric_note: Accuracy; macro-F1 remains below the paper result. This is not a passed protocol calibration.

if_local_opp.label: Local W-path · LOSO
if_local_opp.split: Four saved subject folds, seed 42, 100 epochs; not the paper comparison three-run aggregation.
if_local_opp.dataset_variant: Official W classifier, 63 channels, 24-sample windows / 12-sample stride, Null plus 17 gestures.
if_local_opp.metric_note: Weighted-F1; differs from the Standard 17-class no-Null canonical track.

onehar_released_checkpoint.label: Released checkpoint · author test
onehar_released_checkpoint.split: All five repository-provided test arrays. Training membership is not sufficiently documented to claim canonical subject holdout or LODO.
onehar_released_checkpoint.dataset_variant: 50 Hz, 120 steps, accelerometer only, 1–5 positions. HHAR 6 classes / PAMAP2 9 / RealWorld 8 / UCI-HAR 6 / USC-HAD 7; global nine-class candidates.
onehar_released_checkpoint.metric_note: Per-window accuracy; inference only, no training. The original sensor-count grouping and batch size 256 are preserved. These are local measured values, not paper-table values.

deepconv_original_gesture.label: DeepConvLSTM original · gestures with Null
deepconv_original_gesture.split: OPPORTUNITY challenge train sessions; S2/S3 ADL3 validation; S2/S3 ADL4–5 test.
deepconv_original_gesture.dataset_variant: 113 on-body channels, 17 gestures plus Null; 30 Hz.
deepconv_original_gesture.metric_note: Sample-support weighted F1, Equation 11; Table 4 includes the Null class.

deepconv_original_gesture_no_null.label: DeepConvLSTM original · gestures without Null
deepconv_original_gesture_no_null.split: Original OPPORTUNITY challenge split; Null removed.
deepconv_original_gesture_no_null.dataset_variant: 17 gesture classes, without Null; separate from the 18-class task.
